llm.summary: Files, instructions, and required credentials line up with a Notion sync utility: the code only needs Node and a Notion token and performs only Notion API operations and local file I/O.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (Notion sync) match the included scripts: searching, querying, converting markdown↔Notion, updating/archiving pages, and watching pages. Required binary (node) and required env var (NOTION_API_KEY) are appropriate and necessary for the declared functionality.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and script code are scoped to Notion API calls and local file operations (reading markdown, state files, token file). Scripts only reference expected files/paths (~/ .notion-token, user-supplied markdown paths, state file under memory/ by default) and do not attempt to read unrelated system configuration or contact endpoints other than api.notion.com.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is instruction-only (no install spec). All code is included in the bundle and uses built-in Node modules (https, fs, path, os). There are no downloads from unknown URLs, no extracted archives, and no package registry pulls in the manifest.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The only required environment credential is NOTION_API_KEY (or token file/stdin). The token sources are well-documented and justified. The scripts avoid accepting bare tokens on the command line to reduce exposure. No unrelated secrets or multiple external credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true and will not be force-included. It contains scripts that, when run, write a local state file (watch-notion) and create/modify Notion content (expected behavior). It does not modify other skills or global agent config.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it claims: it needs Node and your Notion integration token and will read/write the files you provide and call api.notion.com. Before installing or using it: (1) limit the integration token's permissions to the minimum required and prefer the token-file method (chmod 600) rather than env vars where possible; (2) only share the Notion pages/databases you intend with the integration; (3) be aware scripts can read local files you pass them (e.g., markdown or stdin) and will write a watch state file by default to memory/notion-watch-state.json in the current directory; (4) review the included scripts if you plan to let the agent invoke the skill autonomously — autonomous invocation is allowed by default and would let the agent call these scripts using your token. If you want extra assurance, run the scripts manually in a controlled environment first.
